description: This file defines the 'Feature' interface used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models a 'Feature' associated with a 'Thing', including methods for managing its ID, definition, properties, and other metadata. It also includes nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Feature.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions for JSON fields related to a Feature, including schema version, definition, and properties.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating a Feature.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current Feature's data for modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the Feature.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves an optional FeatureDefinition attached to the Feature.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Attaches a FeatureDefinition to a copy of the Feature.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the FeatureDefinition from a copy of the Feature.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the features properties if set.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets FeatureProperties on a copy of the Feature.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties from a copy of the Feature.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by JSON pointer.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value at the specified JSON pointer.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes the property at the specified JSON pointer.
